title: Lock the Upgrade Door
description: A live StellarHunts contract exposes an upgrade entrypoint that swaps its WASM. The entrypoint reads the designated upgrader from storage but never checks that the caller is that address. Anyone can now replace the code.
hint: Reading the upgrader from storage proves who is *allowed* to upgrade, not who is calling. Call `require_auth` on the value you just read, not on a caller-supplied argument, and do it before the WASM update so the code can never be replaced first. Prefer a single-purpose upgrader role over the general admin role.
author: StellarHunts Core
